description: View and manage Google Calendar events

requires.rationale: A saved Google browser session is the reliable path for Calendar — no per-scope OAuth app review, and one session covers all Google skills.

auth.setup_instructions: Log in to your Google account via the browser session manager to access Calendar.

listEvents.reason: Reads the agenda, then may open up to 60 event detail popovers (~2s each) on a first read; a kill mid-read loses the whole scrape.

name: Google Calendar
author: flock
